observations: Photo 0 shows a silver-colored automatic transmission with a torque converter attached.
A white label on the transmission casing reads "M278 1282".
The casing shows significant surface dirt and some minor surface rust.
Photo 1 shows the torque converter and the input/output shaft area.
Photo 2 shows the transmission from a side angle with a black fluid leak visible on the brick floor.
Watermarks for "FIDEI AUTOS GLOBAL LIMITED" and "Jiji" are present on all photos.

claims.evidence: No manufacturer's plate or logo is visible in the photos.
No G63 badge or model designation is visible on the transmission casing.
No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or seized gears
risks.proof: A video of the transmission being manually rotated or a test run.
A photo of the transmission with a leak repair kit applied to the leak point.

risks.risk: Missing internal components like the clutch plates or bands
risks.proof: A photo of the transmission with the casing open.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the transmission being operated to confirm it moves and shifts.
Photo of the transmission with the casing open to check internal condition.
Photo of the leak point with a repair kit applied to confirm the leak is sealed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
